text:
Alex R.: ok team — final sync on marketplace launch & joint GTM. We need to lock press embargo time, blog cadence, and marketplace listing cutover. Who has the final copy for PR?
Maria G.: I have the PR draft v3, pushed comments into the doc: https://drive.redwood/release/marketplace-pr-v3 (see section 'partner quotes')
Sam L.: can we confirm embargo window? partner legal asked for 48h heads-up. propose embargo lift Tue 09:00 PST. Thoughts? :eyes:
Jess C.: Tue 09:00 PST works for marketing. Need confirmation from hardware partners (NVIDIA + HPE) for joint statements. Waiting on NVIDIA legal.
Tom H.: HPE signed off on quote yesterday. NVIDIA says "pending logos and final co-marketing MSA" — I pinged their rep.
Maria G.: Landing page checklist: hero copy, 2 product screenshots, pricing bullet, marketplace badges (AWS/GCP/Azure), partner logos, CTA that links to marketplace SKU. I put a draft on the site staging: https://staging.redwood.io/marketplace-launch
Alex R.: pairing items to owners: PR copy — Maria, Partner quotes — Tom, Landing page visual assets — Jess, Marketplace listing metadata + SKUs — Sam. Can we confirm?
Sam L.: confirmed. I'll handle AWS/GCP listings. Need SKU mapping and versioning table. Quick sample in case it helps:
```
product_name: Redwood Inference (Hosted)
sku: RINF-HOST-v1
price_term: per_token
region_availability: us-west-2, eu-west-1
support_tier: standard
```
Jess C.: For the joint blog, marketing needs 300–500 words on partner value prop + 1 partner quote each. Maria — can you work with partners for quotes?
Maria G.: yes. I asked for quotes with deadline EOD Mon. I'll escalate if not received by then.
Tom H.: SI integrators (we've targeting 3 SIs) want a technical appendix and a partner onboarding doc. I have an outline, will share a Confluence page by EOD.
PartnerBot: Reminder: marketplace assets deadline is in 72 hours. See checklist: https://confluence.redwood/marketplace/checklist :bell:
Alex R.: legal signoffs: marketing to coordinate with legal on PR & pricing. Maria — please confirm legal review done before Tue 03:00 PST.
Maria G.: noted, I've put a calendar invite with legal for Mon 22:00 UTC.
Sam L.: deployment plan for listing cutover: staged publish to AWS sandbox -> QA verification -> go-live. Need feature flags in the console to route to marketplace SKU. Devops: @eng-oncall FYI.
Jess C.: does the partner landing page need a special tracking param for co-marketing? we should add UTM params for partner channels.
Alex R.: yes — add utm_source=partner&utm_medium=listing&utm_campaign=marketplace_launch_{partner}. Jess add to staging links.
Tom H.: timeline hack: can we freeze copy by Mon 18:00 PST, run legal review Mon night, and do a tech check Tue 04:00 PST, then lift embargo Tue 09:00 PST? That gives ops time to verify.
Sam L.: schedule looks tight but doable. Ops needs a smoke test plan — I'll draft one.
Maria G.: also need a consolidated assets zip from partners (logos SVG, legal usage text, quotes) by Mon EOD. I'll send a template.
Alex R.: risk list quick: delayed partner quote, AWS listing approval lag, legal changes to pricing language. If any of these hit, fallback is to delay PR until next slot or release PR without partner quote and follow with partner blog. Agree?
Jess C.: agree. Also make sure the landing page has a placeholder "coming soon - partner content" in case logos arrive late.
Tom H.: SI onboarding docs to include contact list and expected SLAs. I'll coordinate with PartnerOps.
Maria G.: final ask — everyone react with :thumbsup: when your deliverable is in-progress. I'll compile for the exec weekly.
Alex R.: great. I'll chair a 15m standup Mon 17:30 PST to confirm freeze. Thanks all. :rocket:
